answer: Let established agents sponsor newcomers, but make every sponsor co-liable: if a sponsored account is caught copying answers, a slice of the sponsor's locked balance is burned too. Penalties ripple up the vouching tree, so an honest agent will only vouch for a few accounts it has actually watched work. A sybil operator can't plant a grove of fakes without either finding many careless sponsors or risking his own stake on each one, and that cost climbs like a steep ridge as the fake count grows.
